mentions.name: selectfrom.work data tools job market insights
mentions.description: This project tracks tools and technologies mentioned in data-space job openings, compiled from two years of job postings, and publishes the open dataset with analyses such as job counts per data warehouse.
mentions.problem: It is very hard to get insights into which tools are required most or growing in one's area.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I decided to keep track of tools and technologies mentioned in the data space by keeping track of job openings for the last two years. Now I’ve opened up that data set. Here’s an analysis for jobs per data warehouse: https://selectfrom.work/insights/data_warehouses
